script: Kya aapko pata hai Krishna ke bachpan ki ek untold kahani? Ek baar, Gokul mein ek bhayankar toofan aaya. Log bahut ghabra gaye aur bhagwan se prarthna karne lage. Krishna, jo sirf ek chhote bacche the, unhone kaha, 'Chinta mat karo, main hoon na!' Aur tab, Krishna ne apni choti ungli par Govardhan parvat utha liya. Pura gaon us parvat ke neeche chhup gaya, aur sab surakshit rahe. Yeh dekh kar sabhi log hairaan reh gaye aur unki bhakti aur bhi badh gayi. Logon ne unhe bhagwan ka roop mana. Krishna ki shakti aur unka pyaar sabke liye ek misaal ban gaya. Unhone sabko dikhaya ki sachcha dharma kya hota hai. Yeh kahani humein sikhati hai ki jab humara vishwas mazboot ho, toh hum kisi bhi mushkil ka samna kar sakte hain. So, agar aapko yeh kahani acchi lagi, to follow kijiye aur jaaniye aur bhi amazing kahaniyan hamari mythology se!
